name: scorify
description: Agent skills from scorify (https://kyr0.github.io/scorify/): score-import finds scores on the web and converts them into scorify scores.

plugins.name: score-import
plugins.description: Find scores on the web and convert MusicXML, MXL, ABC and MIDI into scorify scores, with the vocal melody, every verse of the lyrics, and where each file came from.
